verse.verse_1: Destroyed were the hands of Abu Lahab, and he lay utterly doomed.
verse.verse_2: His wealth did not avail him, nor his acquisitions.
verse.verse_3: Surely, he will be cast into a Flaming Fire
verse.verse_4: along with his wife, that carrier of slanderous tales;
verse.verse_5: upon her neck shall be a rope of palm-fibre.
